name: serpapi_yelp_search
description: Search Yelp places through SerpApi using find_desc and find_loc, with optional attrs filters, sort order, dog-friendly helper, and optional review fetch for a selected or top place. Good for restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and places to eat near a location. Success data includes `results` (place objects with title, rating, address, snippet, url, etc.) and optional `review_data`.

find_desc.description: What to search for on Yelp, such as Coffee, pizza, ramen, brunch, or dog friendly restaurants.

find_loc.description: Location like New York, NY, USA. Defaults to JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION when omitted.

attrs.description: Optional Yelp attrs filter string or list. Example: GoodForKids,DogsAllowed or Smoking.no.

sort_by.description: Optional sort mode. Common values: best_match, rating, review_count, distance.

dogs_allowed.description: If true, automatically appends DogsAllowed to attrs.

place_id.description: Optional Yelp place_id for fetching reviews of a specific place.

include_reviews.description: If true, fetch Yelp reviews for place_id or the top result.

review_limit.description: How many reviews to return when include_reviews is true. Clamped to 1..10. Default: 3.

num_results.description: How many search results to return. Clamped to 1..10. Default: 5.

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

extra_params.description: Additional SerpApi Yelp parameters passed through, excluding reserved keys.

include_raw.description: If true, include raw SerpApi payloads in data.raw and review_data.raw.
